correctness.rationale: For arbitrary finite-dimensional complex projections, C_P and C_Q are orthogonal symmetric-Fock projections. Their cross-range overlap map is Γ(P|_F) with singular cosines precisely the occupation products of one-particle principal cosines. The standard two-projection block yields two commutator singular values t sqrt(1-t²) per nontrivial product, with multiplicities. Zero intersection gives geometric Schatten summability and the exact S2 determinant product; nonzero intersection plus noncommutation gives infinite multiplicity and the exact essential norm by Fock tensor factorization. Rank-one maximizing degree follows from a proved first-difference identity. The included stand-alone exact-fraction checker executed 1705 assertions, but all infinite claims have an analytic proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete exact singular-value classification for pairwise projection-induced composition operators in every finite complex dimension, rather than an arbitrary finite instance. It yields computable all-Schatten norms, exact Hilbert--Schmidt determinant products, a precise common-intersection infinite-multiplicity mechanism, and a sharp rank-one operator-norm discontinuity invisible to earlier qualitative compactness classifications. It connects principal-angle geometry with nonlinear symmetric occupation multiplicities.
